item.title: DOE Office of Nuclear Energy Announces $50M in Funding to Revolutionize Reactor Cladding Material
item.description: New advanced fuel technology could lead to enhanced performance and safety of country’s reactor fleet
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Department of Energy Provides Rare Salt Material to Natura Resources
item.description: The Department of Energy in coordination with Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Idaho National Laboratory completed shipment of more than 4,700 pounds of a rare salt used in molten salt reactors to Natura Resources.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Westinghouse eVinci Microreactor Achieves Criticality Milestone
item.description: Westinghouse Electric Company reached a key milestone earlier this month when it successfully completed criticality testing for its eVinci microreactor.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: More than a Decade of Data to Ensure a Lifetime of Reactor Safety
item.description: Researchers at Argonne National Laboratory in Illinois completed a 14-year campaign to help inform the safety features of new advanced reactor designs.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Department of Energy Awards First Civil Nuclear Credit Payment to California Power Plant
item.description: Today, Pacific Gas and Electric received $271 million to ensure the ongoing operation of Diablo Canyon Power Plant, responsible for producing nearly 10 percent of the state’s total power generation.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Office of Nuclear Energy Celebrates Fifth Advanced Reactor Criticality
item.description: Oklo’s Groves Isotope Test Reactor successfully achieved criticality, becoming the fifth DOE-authorized reactor to go critical this summer.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Energy Department to Distribute Third Round of HALEU to NASA and Radiant
item.description: U.S. Department of Energy made conditional commitments to provide high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU) to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) and Radiant Industries, Inc. to meet near-term fuel needs.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Department of Energy Celebrates Fourth Criticality Ahead of July 4th Goal
item.description: Early Saturday, as part of the U.S. Department of Energy Reactor Pilot Program, Aalo Atomics’ advanced reactor design, Aalo-X, successfully completed a zero-power fueled criticality demonstration.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: U.S. Department of Energy Meets President Trump’s Goal, Delivers Third Advanced Reactor Criticality
item.description: Deployable Energy’s demonstration reactor, Unity, successfully achieved criticality, marking the fulfillment of President Trump’s executive order directing DOE to authorize three advanced reactors with the goal of achieving criticality in each by July 4, 2026.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov

item.title: Department of Energy Announces American Nuclear Supply Chain Loans
item.description: Financing will help rebuild America's nuclear supply chain and accelerate deployment of 10 new large-scale reactors.
item.dc:creator: Energy.gov
